note: Integrity and provenance lock for the vendored SteamDB FileDetectionRuleSets rules.ini. sha256 is computed over the committed rules.ini bytes as stored (UTF-8 without BOM, LF line endings), so an external `sha256sum rules.ini` on a fresh checkout reproduces it, matching .gitattributes normalization. A drift test in fragcap-profile recomputes it from the embedded bytes.
